# Reusable Prompts

Store reusable task prompts as `*.prompt.md` files in this folder.

## When To Use Prompts vs Agents

- Use a prompt for one focused task with parameters.
- Use an agent for an ongoing role with its own behavior and tool constraints.

## Naming

Use lowercase, hyphenated filenames:

- `ba-kickoff.prompt.md`
- `git-operations.prompt.md`
- `workspace-setup.prompt.md`
- `story-refinement.prompt.md`
- `risk-assessment.prompt.md`
